unstated.behaviour: The person is held per browser by an HttpOnly cookie (stillroom_session) mapped to a server-side session; tabs of one browser share it, a separate browser context is another person. Switch person in one tab changes the person shown in the other tab of the same browser on its next poll.
unstated.evidence: Playwright: context A Continue as Maya, sent "hello from Maya"; context B Continue as Theo, sent "hello from Theo"; after reload A shows Maya with only her 2 messages, B shows Theo with only his; a further send from A landed in Maya's conversation. Second tab in context A showed Maya; after that tab did Switch person -> Continue as Ana, tab 1 showed "Ana" with an empty transcript within 3 s. API: two cookie jars got distinct cookies.

unstated.behaviour: Every action resolves the person from the cookie session on the server; ids from another person's workspace are looked up only inside the caller's workspace, so they return 404; a personId that does not match the session returns 401.
unstated.evidence: As Ana, POST /api/action selectConversation/editMemory/forgetMemory/confirmProposal/send with Maya's botId, threadId, memory id and proposal id -> 404 {"error":"That item is no longer available."}; send with personId "maya" -> 401 "Select your person again before continuing."; forged cookie -> 401. Maya afterwards still had memory "likes tea", proposal still pending, and "what is the status of ORD-1001" -> "The status of ORD-1001 is open."
unstated.test_name: TC-5 memory stays scoped by bot and person (only selectBot of another person's bot -> 404)

unstated.behaviour: The first screen holds only the three Continue as buttons; Setup appears inside the workspace after a person continues, with Send disabled until a token is saved. Saving a token requires a person first (API refuses with 401). After Switch person, a reload stays on the chooser.
unstated.evidence: Empty data, GET / in Playwright: visible buttons ["Continue as Maya","Continue as Theo","Continue as Ana"], Setup and Message not visible. POST saveToken before continuing -> 401. After Continue as Maya: Setup visible, Send disabled; after saving sk-local-abcdefghijkl Setup hidden. Switch person then reload -> Continue as buttons visible, Message not visible.
unstated.test_name: TC-1 (send before continueAs -> 401), TC-2 (continue before token)

unstated.behaviour: A valid PROVIDER_TOKEN wins over a saved token and is used only while set; it is never copied to the data folder. While a valid token is in use, Save token is not offered and a saveToken call returns 200 without saving anything. Not stated in the documents.
unstated.evidence: PROVIDER_TOKEN=sk-local-abcdefghijkl: state configured true, "who are you" -> "I am Assistant. I have no special instructions."; saveToken sk-local-yyyyyyyyyyyyyy -> 200 configured=true; workspace.json contains neither abcdefghijkl nor yyyy. Restart without the variable -> configured false (Setup shown again). With a saved token, a second saveToken sk-local-zzzzzzzzzzzzzz -> 200 and workspace.json still holds only the first token.

unstated.behaviour: An invalid PROVIDER_TOKEN is treated as unsaved: Setup is shown, sending is refused with a message pointing to setup, and a valid token saved through Setup works at once. A refused token in Setup shows an alert and can be retried.
unstated.evidence: PROVIDER_TOKEN=not-a-token: configured false; send "hello" -> 409 "Save a valid provider token before sending a message."; saveToken sk-local-abcdefghijkl -> 200 configured=true; "hello" -> "You said: \"hello\". ...". sk-local-short via API -> 400 "The provider rejected this token. Check its format and try again."; in the page sk-local-abc showed that text in the Setup alert and the field stayed usable.

unstated.behaviour: The saved token is stored in plain text in DATA_DIR/workspace.json (file mode 600). It never appears in API responses, the page, or server output; any sk-local- token text in messages and replies is replaced by "[token hidden]". Provider errors show a generic alert.
unstated.evidence: After Save token: workspace.json includes "sk-local-abcdefghijkl", mode 600; GET /api/state JSON contains no "sk-local-"; page HTML does not contain it; "hello [fail once]" -> reply.error "The reply could not finish. Retry to try the same message again."; server output only "Stillroom is available at http://localhost:47313". Sending "my key is sk-local-abcdefghijkl ok" stored and echoed as "my key is [token hidden] ok".
unstated.test_name: every test via the call() helper (asserts no response contains the token); TC-2

unstated.behaviour: Empty and blank names are refused (browser required field, server 400). Names over 80 characters are refused by the server; in the page the field's maxlength cuts a pasted or typed name to 80 characters silently. Duplicate names are accepted and the bots are indistinguishable in the Bots navigation (same text, same title, same accessible name).

Playwright: empty Save bot name -> validationMessage "Please fill out this field."; second bot "Assistant" created; Bots nav buttons: [{"name":"✦Assistant","title":"Assistant","current":"true"},{"name":"✦Assistant","title":"Assistant","current":"false"}]; filling 300 "z" left 80 in the field and a bot with an 80-character name was created without a message.

unstated.behaviour: Send is disabled while a reply is pending and the server refuses a second send in that conversation (409); a replayed request id is accepted once. unstated.behaviour: The app stays up and other conversations work, but a task whose step cannot be recorded stops silently and keeps showing Running (with Cancel task) forever, even after write access returns; it becomes Interrupted only after a restart.

unstated.behaviour: After Send focus stays in Message; after Confirm changes or Reject changes focus moves to that proposal's Change result region (Enter there does nothing); after Save memory focus falls to the page body.

unstated.behaviour: Malformed or unexpected requests get specific 4xx messages; unexpected errors get a 500 "The workspace could not complete this action. defects.title: Sending a new message after a failed reply hides the failure and disables its Retry
defects.repro: Fresh data, valid token, Continue as Maya. Send "hello [fail once]"; the alert and Retry appear. Instead of Retry, send "next". Then POST /api/action {"action":"retry","id":<id of the hello message>, botId, threadId}.
defects.observed: Transcript shows "hello [fail once]", "next", reply to next; no alert, no Retry button; the retry call returns 200 and the message stays failed with no reply.
defects.expected: The failed message stays marked as failed with a way to resend it, or the person is told to retry first.

defects.title: A reply whose result cannot be saved stays pending forever and blocks the conversation after storage recovers
defects.repro: Start the app, Continue as Maya, send "hello [slow]"; within 1 s run chmod 555 on DATA_DIR; wait 5 s; chmod 755 DATA_DIR; send "another" in the same conversation.
defects.observed: "preparing a reply…" remains indefinitely; the new send is refused with 409 "Wait for the current reply before sending again." until the server is restarted, when the message becomes failed.
defects.expected: The reply is reported as failed (with Retry) when it cannot be saved, and the conversation is usable once storage works again.

defects.title: A background task whose step cannot be saved keeps showing Running forever
defects.repro: STANDIN_STEP_MS=1500. Send "long task: rotest [long]"; after 1 s chmod 555 DATA_DIR; wait 4 s; chmod 755 DATA_DIR; wait 3 s; read Task status.
defects.observed: Task status Running with 0 finished steps and Cancel task offered, never advancing; becomes Interrupted only after a server restart.
defects.expected: The task is marked Failed or Interrupted with Retry task, or resumes once storage works.

defects.title: Conversations cannot be told apart in the Conversations navigation
defects.repro: Click New conversation twice; then in two new conversations send "Please look up the latest order details and status history for customer Northwind" and "...Southwind". Read the Conversations buttons.
defects.observed: Three buttons named "Untitled conversation"; two buttons both named "Please look up the latest order details and status histo".
defects.expected: Each conversation identifiable before opening it.

defects.title: Bots with the same name are indistinguishable
defects.repro: Click New bot, Bot name "Assistant", Save bot name; read the Bots navigation.
defects.observed: Two buttons with text, title and accessible name "Assistant".
defects.expected: Duplicate refused, or each bot distinguishable before selecting it.

defects.title: Forgetting something not remembered is reported as forgotten
defects.repro: Send "remember that likes tea", then "forget tea".
defects.observed: Reply "I've forgotten \"tea\"." with no notice; Memory still lists "likes tea".
defects.expected: A notice that nothing matched, or the matching fact removed and shown.

defects.title: Saving an instruction or task under an existing name silently overwrites it
defects.repro: Save instruction A = "x"; without Edit, save instruction A = "y".
defects.observed: One entry A with text "y"; no notice that "x" was replaced.
defects.expected: Overwrite with a notice, refuse, or ask.

defects.title: add step feedback does not identify which of several tasks received it
defects.repro: In one conversation send "long task: same [long]" twice, then "add step: extra"; read both Task: same articles.
defects.observed: Both articles identical (Running, "Working in the background."); the receiving task's "Added a step" detail is overwritten within one step; bot text says only "the task that is running".
defects.expected: Feedback naming or marking the task that got the step.

defects.title: Since you were away never changes after the person returns
defects.repro: Start and finish a task, reload several times, then start two more, close the tab until they end, reopen; reload again.
defects.observed: The region lists every task ever started (including ones seen before leaving), identical after each reload, never dismissed, no waiting proposals.
defects.expected: Reports what changed since the last visit, and reported items stop appearing after being read or a reload.

defects.title: Damaged or unwritable data folder crashes the server with a raw stack trace
defects.repro: Write '{"version":1}' (or invalid JSON) to DATA_DIR/workspace.json and run node server.js; or point DATA_DIR at a folder with mode 555.
defects.observed: Exit 1 with an uncaught stack trace (TypeError in allThreads / SyntaxError in openStore / EACCES); no recovery advice.
defects.expected: A clear message naming the file and the recovery step, keeping the damaged file.

defects.title: Unexpected errors are logged without any detail
defects.repro: chmod 555 DATA_DIR while the app runs and click Save instruction; read the server output.
defects.observed: Page: "The workspace could not complete this action. Try again."; server output only "Workspace operation failed."
defects.expected: Server output records the error (without the token); page says what to try.

defects.title: Lookup of a nonexistent id with a valid prefix answers about another record
defects.repro: As Maya send "what is the status of ORD-1001A".
defects.expected: A reply that ORD-1001A cannot be found.

defects.title: Focus is lost after Save memory
defects.repro: Remember a fact, Edit memory, change text, Tab to Save memory and press Enter; read document.activeElement.
defects.expected: Focus on the updated item or a nearby control.

extras.what: Generate local token button in Setup
extras.why: Makes offline setup one click; it only works because the stand-in accepts any well-formed token, so it does not explain a real provider token.

extras.what: Redaction of any sk-local- token text in typed messages and replies
extras.why: Protects a pasted token, but silently alters what the person typed.

extras.what: Loopback-only listening, Host and Origin checks, CSP and no-store headers
extras.why: Stops other sites and hosts from driving the cookie-only persona selector.

extras.what: Example prompt buttons on an empty conversation
extras.why: Helps a first-time person get a useful reply.

extras.what: Light and dark themes, skip link
extras.why: Polish not asked for; no harm observed.

spec_notes: The specification is mostly a test plan. R-4 marks "Default: identity, type and reader fields are managed by the app. Only existing business fields may be edited, preserving their value types" (account owner therefore editable). R-5 marks "Default: a stopped server leaves tasks interrupted for explicit retry". R-1 says the token is kept "out of responses and client storage" without saying it is stored in plain text on disk; token precedence between PROVIDER_TOKEN and a saved token is not stated. R-1 pins "a saved operator token serves all three personas", a choice a correct product need not share. Stale-proposal refusal, retry-from-failed-step and cancellation keeping finished steps appear as unmarked check lines. Silent on duplicate names, conversation naming, Since you were away semantics, storage failure and damaged data. R-6 claims narrow-window and keyboard-focus checks, but nothing in npm test performs them.
tests_notes: test/browser.cjs only registers its test when NODE_TEST_CONTEXT is unset, so npm test lists it as passed while running nothing; all UI behaviour (focus, narrow layout, live updates, named regions) is untested by the suite. TC-1..TC-9 each cover many behaviours at once (e.g. TC-6 covers authorisation, clarify, reject, apply-once, conflict, readers refusal and restart). Tests are tied to the internal API: action names (continueAs, confirmProposal), the state shape (conversation.proposals, bot.instructionId), proposal status strings (invalid, conflict, applied) and exact detail text ("Step 2 failed. Retry to continue from this step."); another correct build would fail them. TC-8 relies on a 65 ms delay against 35 ms steps. browser.cjs checks element ids and CSS values (border radius 50%, min-width 0px).
maintainer: All state lives in one JSON snapshot copied and rewritten on every write, and the reply and task workers assume every write succeeds: when one throws, the in-flight reply or task is left pending or Running with no path back except restart. The page renders by JSON-diffing each region (replace with data-focus keys) on a 320 ms poll, so changing markup or focus behaviour risks breaking focus restoration and live updates that no npm test covers.
